behaviour: Unit tests for the page model helpers and per-page fractional indices.
rules: Build elements with `API.createElement` from `@excalidraw/excalidraw/tests/helpers/api` and pass `pageId` via spread (`{ ...API.createElement({ type: "rectangle" }), pageId: "p2" }`); import helpers from `@excalidraw/element`.

tests.name: getDefaultPage is deterministic
tests.given: two calls
tests.expect: equal objects with id page-1 and name Page 1

tests.name: createPage appends after the last visible page
tests.given: the default page list
tests.expect: two pages, the new one with a greater index, active list order by getVisiblePages

tests.name: renamePage rejects empty names
tests.given: a page renamed to '   '
tests.expect: the same array reference is returned

tests.name: renamePage bumps version
tests.given: a page renamed to 'SDK flow'
tests.expect: name 'SDK flow' and version + 1

tests.name: movePage reorders and refuses edges
tests.given: pages A,B,C; move C left, then move A left
tests.expect: order A,C,B; second call returns the same reference

tests.name: deletePage refuses the last page and tombstones otherwise
tests.given: one page, then two pages
tests.expect: same reference for one page; isDeleted true and hidden from getVisiblePages for two

tests.name: getAdjacentPageId prefers the next page
tests.given: pages A,B,C
tests.expect: B for A, C for B, B for C

tests.name: restorePages repairs invalid input
tests.given: undefined, [], entries without ids, and duplicate ids
tests.expect: a default page for the empty cases and the first of each duplicate id

tests.name: restoreActivePageId falls back to the first visible page
tests.given: an unknown id and a deleted page id
tests.expect: the first visible page id

tests.name: reconcilePages takes the higher version
tests.given: local and remote copies of one page with versions 2 and 3
tests.expect: the remote copy; equal versions keep the lower versionNonce

tests.name: repairElementPages moves dangling elements and cuts cross-page links
tests.given: an element without pageId, one with an unknown pageId, and an arrow bound to an element on another page
tests.expect: both moved to the active page and the arrow binding set to null

tests.name: syncInvalidIndices validates each page separately
tests.given: elements of two pages whose indices interleave
tests.expect: no index of a valid page is rewritten and validateFractionalIndices does not throw

behaviour: Unit tests for serializing and restoring multi-page drawings and legacy files.

tests.name: serializeAsJSON and restore round-trip every page
tests.given: an appState with three pages, a renamed page, a reorder, a viewport for a non-active page and elements on each page, serialized with serializeAsJSON 'local' then parsed and restored with restoreAppState and restoreElements
tests.expect: the same page ids, names, order, pageViewports, activePageId and every element with its pageId

tests.name: a legacy file restores onto one default page
tests.given: file JSON without pages and elements without pageId loaded with loadFromBlob
tests.expect: appState.pages is [default page], activePageId page-1 and every element has pageId page-1

tests.name: dangling page references are repaired
tests.given: a file whose element names a missing page and whose activePageId is unknown, loaded with loadFromBlob
tests.expect: activePageId is the first page and the element moved to it

tests.name: duplicate page ids keep the first entry
tests.given: appState.pages with two entries sharing an id
tests.expect: restoreAppState returns one page with the first entry's name

tests.name: restoreElements drops a malformed pageId
tests.given: an element with pageId 42
tests.expect: the restored element has no pageId

behaviour: jsdom integration tests that drive the page tab bar and assert page-scoped rendering, selection, history, viewports, export, search and insertion.
rules: Render `<Excalidraw handleKeyboardGlobally />` with `render` from `./test-utils`; drive the tab bar with `fireEvent.click` on `getByTestId` ids `page-add`, `page-tab-<id>`, `page-rename`, `page-rename-input`, `page-move-left`, `page-move-right`, `page-delete`; read state from `window.h`.

Spy on the static renderer with `vi.spyOn(StaticScene, ...)` only if the existing tests do; otherwise assert on `h.app.scene.getNonDeletedElements()` and `h.app.visibleElements`, which feed the renderer.

tests.name: creating a page adds an active empty tab
tests.given: a rectangle on page 1, then a click on page-add
tests.expect: two tabs, the new one aria-selected, h.app.scene.getNonDeletedElements() empty and scroll 0/0 zoom 1 (AC-1)

tests.name: only the active page's elements render and are selectable
tests.given: a rectangle on page 1 and an ellipse at the same spot on page 2
tests.expect: on page 2 the scene and visibleElements hold only the ellipse; select-all and a click on that spot select only the ellipse (AC-2)

tests.name: renaming a page updates the tab and saved data
tests.given: page-rename, typing 'Data pipeline' and Enter, then a rename to '  '
tests.expect: tab text 'Data pipeline', serializeAsJSON contains the name, and the empty rename keeps it (AC-3)

tests.name: reordering pages changes tab and saved order
tests.given: three pages and page-move-left on the third
tests.expect: tab order 1,3,2 and getVisiblePages order in appState matches (AC-4)

tests.name: deleting a page removes its tab and elements
tests.given: page 2 with a rectangle, page-delete and confirm
tests.expect: one tab, the rectangle isDeleted in getSceneElementsIncludingDeleted, page 1 active and page-delete disabled (AC-5)

tests.name: undo stays on its page
tests.given: a rectangle created on page A, a switch to page B where an ellipse is created, then undo on B and a switch back to A and undo
tests.expect: undo on B removes only the ellipse and never changes the rectangle; undo on A removes the rectangle; switching records no history entry (AC-6)

tests.name: each page keeps its own viewport
tests.given: scrollX 100 and zoom 2 on page A, a switch to page B and back
tests.expect: page B at 0/0 zoom 1, page A back at 100 and zoom 2 (AC-7)

tests.name: export contains only the active page
tests.given: elements on two pages and page 2 active
tests.expect: the elements given to the export-to-clipboard action (copyAsPng/copyAsSvg path via actionManager) are only page 2's (AC-8)

tests.name: search finds text on another page and switches to it
tests.given: a text 'pipeline' on page 2 while page 1 is active, search for 'pipeline' and click the result
tests.expect: the result is labelled with page 2's name and activePageId becomes page 2 (AC-11)

tests.name: paste and library insert add to the active page
tests.given: page 2 active and h.app.addElementsFromPasteOrLibrary with a rectangle
tests.expect: the inserted element has pageId of page 2 and page 1 is unchanged (AC-14)

tests.name: view mode shows switch-only tabs
tests.given: viewModeEnabled true with two pages
tests.expect: tabs are clickable and switch pages; page-add, page-rename and page-delete are absent

tests.name: zen mode hides the tab bar
tests.given: zenModeEnabled true
tests.expect: no page-tab-bar in the DOM

behaviour: App tests for page sync through the reconcile/broadcast path, the Firebase-saved room and localStorage persistence.
rules: Mock `../../excalidraw-app/data/firebase.ts` and `socket.io-client` exactly as `excalidraw-app/tests/collab.test.tsx` does; render `<ExcalidrawApp />` and drive the second client by calling `window.collab.handleRemotePagesUpdate(pages)` and `window.collab.excalidrawAPI.updateScene` with reconciled remote elements, as a remote socket message would.

For the Firebase room, test `excalidraw-app/data/firebase.ts` in a separate `describe` that mocks `../data/firebaseSDK` with an in-memory firestore (`doc`, `getDoc`, `runTransaction`, `Bytes.fromUint8Array`) and real `encryptData`/`decryptData` with a fixed room key.

tests.name: remote page create, rename, reorder and delete reach the local client
tests.given: remote page lists with a new page, a higher-version rename, a moved index and a tombstone
tests.expect: local appState.pages follows each change and the local active page is kept unless it was deleted, in which case the first visible page becomes active (AC-12)

tests.name: concurrent edits on different pages do not clobber each other
tests.given: a local element on page 1 and a remote element on page 2 reconciled together
tests.expect: both elements exist with their own pageId and page 1's element is unchanged (AC-12)

tests.name: broadcast payloads carry pages
tests.given: a page rename while collaborating with Portal.broadcastScene spied
tests.expect: broadcastScene is called and the payload built for it includes the renamed pages (AC-12)

tests.name: the Firebase room keeps every page
tests.given: saveToFirebase with two pages and elements on both, then loadFromFirebase
tests.expect: both pages and all elements come back (AC-12)

tests.name: a legacy Firebase room loads onto one page
tests.given: a stored document without pagesCiphertext
tests.expect: loadFromFirebase returns the default page and the elements (AC-12, NFR-1)

tests.name: localStorage keeps all pages across a reload
tests.given: two pages with elements, the LocalData save flushed, then importFromLocalStorage and a fresh render
tests.expect: the restored appState has both pages, names, order and activePageId and every element keeps its pageId (AC-13)
